actionAdapters.when: Unity 已连接且稳定，并已冻结唯一 BuildTarget 与可选 YooAsset Package；仅执行只读规则检查

actionAdapters.entry: current Build Settings, ProjectSettings/Nova/Globals.json and Action result rule evidence
actionAdapters.when: 只读解释当前快照和规则来源，不修改 ProjectSettings、资产或生成物

deny: all project source, ProjectSettings, Build Settings, Config, Scene, Prefab, Collector and package writes
platform switch, Config export, HybridCLR generation, Android Resolve, Bundle or Player build
cache cleanup, output deletion, device installation, credential use, external write, Git commit or push

requiredFor: starting Unity or changing the selected project, BuildTarget or Package
switching platform, modifying any failed rule, exporting Config, resolving dependencies, generating artifacts, building, deleting, installing, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 只读检查授权绑定唯一项目、BuildTarget 和可选 Package；它不授权修复、生成或构建。任一输入变化后重新冻结请求。

evidence: 运行中的 nova.project.build.inspect-readiness Descriptor 与本次冻结请求
目标 BuildTarget、activeBuildTarget 与 Build Support 规则
启用场景、Globals ConfigMaster 绑定、三维坐标与 ConfigRuntimeSO 一致性规则
YooAsset Settings、Collector、目标 Package 与 HybridCLR 前置规则
data.ready、错误/警告计数、逐条规则及未执行任何修复或构建的边界
